design_basis: NHL_SIDES_TOTALS_DESIGN.md section 2: dispersion parameter fit on design data
dispersion_method: method of moments, Var = phi * mean, phi = sum((g-mu)^2)/sum(mu), floored at 1.0; mu = MoneyPuck xGoals (for/against), g = actual goals (for/against)
dispersion_reading: The raw estimate lands BELOW the Poisson floor (0.8208) on this design set: each game's own xG already absorbs game-level variation that a rate-based mean would leave in the residuals. The floored value phi = 1.0 (pure Poisson) is the build-stage constant. A residuals-around-strictly-prior-rates dispersion fit is the alternative reading; the freeze package adjudicates. Recorded, not smoothed over.
fit_stage: BUILD_STAGE — NOT FROZEN; the freeze fit governs

observables_for_the_record.note: margin-0 finals are shootout games in shot-derived data (the SO-deciding goal is not a shot). The OT-vs-SO split of regulation ties and the OT/SO winner split are NOT identifiable from this surface: a one-goal final conflates regulation and OT decisions. See BUILD_RECORD.md, readings.
